title: Alibaba, Tencent, Moonshot Reportedly Curb Offensive Cyber Capabilities; Qwen Flagship Not Open-Weight
summary: Alibaba, Tencent and Moonshot reportedly reduced offensive cyber capabilities in their new models while improving defensive performance, Bloomberg reported. Alibaba&\#x27;s latest flagship Qwen model is not open-weight, so users cannot download and customize the full version. The changes come as China&\#x27;s Ministry of Commerce considers draft export controls announced last month that would ban exports of AI tools capable of attacking critical infrastructure or government networks; Tencent reportedly cut cyber functions before releasing Hy4 this month.
